discharge_summary_01.txt.summary: A 58-year-old male with hypertension and type 2 diabetes presented with acute chest pain and shortness of breath. ECG showed ST elevation and troponin was 4.5 ng/ml. He underwent urgent PCI with stent placement. Patient denies current fever. Discharged on updated cardiac medications.

cardiology_consult_02.docx.summary: Patient presents with progressive dyspnea and lower extremity edema due to decompensated heart failure with LVEF 35%. Furosemide dosage increased.

lab_report_03.pdf.summary: Laboratory results indicate uncontrolled type 2 diabetes with elevated HbA1c 9.2%, fasting blood glucose 210 mg/dl, serum creatinine 1.8 mg/dl, and dyslipidemia.

emergency_note_04.txt.summary: Patient evaluated for persistent headache and dizziness for 5 days. History of childhood asthma. Head CT scan normal. Discharged with acetaminophen.

outpatient_note_05.pdf.summary: Outpatient visit for annual checkup and right knee osteoarthritis pain. Physical exam showed crepitus without acute effusion. Managed with physical therapy and analgesics.
